2. The sublist `ts` also satisfies `MultiGeachConfluent ts rel`.

By the inductive hypothesis, we assume that the sublist `ts` meets both conditions. Therefore, by construction, the entire list `t :: ts` also meets both conditions, thereby establishing that the list is multi-geach-confluent.

    le_sSup := fun _ a haS => (WithTop.isLUB_sSup' ⟨a, haS⟩).1 haS
    sSup_le := fun S a ha => by
      rcases S.eq_empty_or_nonempty with h | h
      · show ite _ _ _ ≤ a

        · rw [h] at h₁
          cases h₁
        · convert bot_le (a := a)

          simp only [h, preimage_empty, WithBot.sSup_empty]
        · exfalso
          apply h₂
          use ⊥
          rw [h]
          rintro b ⟨⟩
      · exact (WithTop.isLUB_sSup' h).2 ha
    sInf_le := fun S a haS =>
      show ite _ _ _ ≤ a by
        simp only [OrderBot.bddBelow, not_true_eq_false, or_false]
        split_ifs with h₁
        · cases a

          cases h₁ haS
        · cases a
